title: nhsx/SynthVAE
summary: NHS England's AI Skunkworks project generating synthetic patient data with a differentially private variational autoencoder, evaluated with SDMetrics. One of the clearest public-sector uses of the SDV evaluation stack as a neutral yardstick.

title: opendp/smartnoise-sdk
summary: OpenDP's differential privacy toolkit; its synthesizer package incorporates CTGAN alongside DP-specific generators, making CTGAN a component of a mainstream DP library.

title: VectorInstitute/midst-toolkit
summary: Vector Institute toolkit for membership inference against synthetic tabular data, using SDV synthesizers as attack targets.

title: mostly-ai/paper-fidelity-accuracy
summary: Companion code to a MOSTLY AI paper comparing synthetic data fidelity and downstream accuracy; SDV synthesizers appear as comparison baselines. An example of a commercial competitor benchmarking against SDV.

title: croesuslab/RCTGAN
summary: Relational CTGAN: extends CTGAN to multi-table databases as an alternative to SDV's HMA, and benchmarks against it.

title: seedatnabeel/3S-Testing
summary: Small-subgroup synthetic testing of ML models, using CTGAN variants to generate subgroup data for stress-testing model performance.

title: johnnyxcy/pytrial
summary: Clinical trial ML toolkit whose trial-simulation module wraps CopulaGAN and related SDV models to synthesize patient records.

title: trinhthechuong/SynOmicsBench
summary: Benchmark of synthetic data generators for omics data, with CTGAN as one of the evaluated synthesizers.

title: Unique-Divine/GANs-for-Genomics
summary: Applies CTGAN to genomic tabular data.

title: Faruman/Comparison_FinancialDataGeneration
summary: Comparison of generative models for financial transaction data, running a locally modified copy of SDV's single-table synthesizers.

title: KI-AIM/Cinnamon
summary: Synthetization platform from the KI-AIM project offering CTGAN among its tabular generation algorithms behind a common interface.

title: KaiChen9909/tab_bench
summary: Benchmark suite for tabular generative models including CTGAN and DP variants.

title: omaralvarez/gentab
summary: Library wrapping multiple tabular generators, including SDV single-table synthesizers, behind one API for oversampling experiments.

title: yoid2000/commute-health-study
summary: Reproduction study testing whether conclusions from a commuting-and-health paper survive when the underlying data is replaced by synthetic data, with SDV as one of the generators.

title: ewvanwinkle/SyntheticDataVault
summary: A 2017 GTRI internship reimplementation of the DSAA'16 SDV algorithm for relational databases, predating the official open-source release. Evidence of early independent uptake of the paper.

title: Diyago/Tabular-data-generation
summary: GAN-based tabular augmentation project carrying a CTGAN implementation; widely referenced tutorial-style repo.
